segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for jumping on. I wanted to run through the onboarding plan for the calibration module and make sure March 4 still works on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: March 4 is still the target. I did want to ask about the kickoff invite, though. We had said Thursday, February 15, because our quality lead is at a supplier audit until then. The invite came over for Tuesday the 13th.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Ah, okay, yeah, sorry about that. Thursday the 15th at 10:00 Central is fine. I’ll have the implementation coordinator move the series today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thanks. The other thing is seats. The worksheet we got from your onboarding team shows 25 named users, but the order form has 32. We need all 32 for the first lab group.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, you’re right, 32 named users on the annual plan. I’ll get that corrected before they provision the tenant, so nobody is waiting on access.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. We’re assigning 18 technicians, 6 supervisors, and 8 read-only managers. Same split we discussed last week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That split works. The read-only managers won’t count against technician permissions, and the supervisors can approve calibration records and edit schedules.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Invoice timing is still February 28 net 30?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, $46,800 due March 29, and services are the separate $7,200 line. No change there.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If you can send the updated invite and seat confirmation by end of day, we’re set.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll have both before 5:00 Eastern.
